consent-attestation.label: Per-subject consent attestation
consent-attestation.body:
## Consent attestation

Subject `{subject_id}` consented to the depicted use of their likeness for scope `{scope}` on {consent_date}. Evidence reference: `{evidence}`. This attestation is recorded in the rights ledger and covers job `{job_id}` only.

proxy-work-warning.label: Notice attached when the run used a non-neural proxy path
proxy-work-warning.body: NOTICE: job {job_id} completed through the deterministic ffmpeg proxy path, not through neural model inference. The delivered file is suitable for pipeline validation and review scaffolding only; it is not a neural-generation deliverable.
